knobs.note: Read by bin/env-diff.sh as ${ENV_DIFF:-1}; 0 stops the lane before it reads or writes anything (BH-19).
Read by bin/env-diff.sh as ${ENV_DIFF_BOX:-$(hostname)}: the box name the alert carries. NOT settable from the control plane — it is an identity, so only env/global.env on the box moves it (BH-19).

Read by bin/env-diff.sh as ${ENV_DIFF_MAX_ITEMS:-20}: how many changes the alert line lists before it says (+N more); the full list is always in logs/env-diff.log. 0 or non-numeric falls back to 20 (BH-19).
